articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 43/2025

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Jak vhodné jsou pro život hyceánské světy? Poprvé pozorovali dvojici černých děr na společné oběžné dráze. Nový světový rekord v rychlosti sekvenování celého lidského genomu. Nový přepínač mezi supravodičem, izolátorem a zvláštním kvantovým mezistavem.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Hacking pošty v době předinternetové

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Windows 11 CDkey na Halloween od Goodoffer24 jen za €20.00 a strašidelně nízké ceny i za další software, jako například Windows 11 Home Professional od Goodoffer24.com a budete připraveni s novým operačním systémem na další práci bez obav. Na Goodoffer24 totiž můžete koupit také hry nebo aplikace Office.
articles.title: Neděste se upgradu: Windows 11 Pro na Halloween jen za €20.00 na Goodoffer24

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Epson EcoTank L6370: Tank pro kancelář i domácnost s mimořádně levným provozem. Zebra v Praze ukázala AI dvojníky i vzdělávání s virtuální realitou. Data se ztrácí čím dál více, navzdory chytřejším postupům a rekordním výdajům na bezpečnost. Útočníci nevyvíjejí nové metody, ale zdokonalují ty stávající. Agentní AI v prohlížečích: nová vrstva bezpečnostních rizik pro podniky. AWS Cloud Day Prague 2025: Technologická událost roku se vrací s důrazem na využití generativní AI v praxi. Co pro firmy znamená konec podpory Windows 10. AI nyní nahrazuje především mladé a vzdělané – možná. SAP ukázal, jak propojuje AI, data a aplikace.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: AI nyní nahrazuje především mladé a vzdělané – možná

articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 42/2025

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Starověká tělesa optikou informatiky. Temná hmota a temná energie mohou být pouze kosmickou iluzí. Na Marsu byl asi i dávný oceán.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Jak souvisí krystaly křemíku s kosmickými strunami?

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Halloween je tady a s ním i strašidelné ceny za software! Tak neváhejte a kupte Windows 11 CDkey jen za €20.00 nebo Windows 11 Home Professional od Goodoffer24.com a budete připraveni s novým operačním systémem bez obav že byste nemohli pracovat a hrát si, protože na Goodoffer24 můžete koupit také hry nebo aplikace Office.
articles.title: Neděste se upgradu: Windows 11 Pro na Halloween jen za €20.00 na Goodoffer24

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Česko získalo svou továrnu na umělou inteligenci a s ní i nový AI superpočítač. Ransomware zasahuje nejen firemní data, ale i morálku zaměstnanců. Huawei na summitu v Mnichově: Wi-Fi nové generace a datová centra s nepřetržitým provozem. Novinky HP pro efektivní hybridní prostředí. České firmy využívají AI méně než slovenské. Pět klíčových kyberbezpečnostních výzev středoevropského finančního sektoru.

articles.description: V kvantovém světě by mohly existovat i antagonistické interakce . Ani bosony, ani fermiony – fyzikové našli novou třídu částic. Dočkáme se průletové mise kolem mezihvězdné komety? Máme šanci pozorovat závěrečnou explozi primordiálních černých děr?
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: ChatGPT řeší starořecký problém zdvojnásobení obsahu čtverce

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Americký výrobce čipů Nvidia se stal první firmou na světě, jejíž tržní hodnota dosáhla pěti bilionů USD (104,5 bilionu Kč). Nvidia stojí v čele světového trhu s čipy pro umělou inteligenci (AI) a výrazně těží z prudkého růstu zájmu o tuto technologii. Nvidia již byla první firmou, která překonala hranici čtyř bilionů USD, a to letos v červenci.
articles.title: Nvidia je první firmou, jejíž tržní hodnota dosáhla 5 bilionů dolarů

articles.description: Po Canonicalu a SUSE oznámil také Red Hat, že bude podporovat a distribuovat toolkit NVIDIA CUDA (Wikipedie).
articles.title: Red Hat bude podporovat a distribuovat toolkit NVIDIA CUDA

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: TrueNAS (Wikipedie), tj. open source storage platforma postavená na Linuxu, byl vydán ve verzi 25.10 Goldeye. Přináší NVMe over Fabric (NVMe-oF) nebo OpenZFS 2.3.4.
articles.title: TrueNAS 25.10 Goldeye

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána OpenIndiana 2025.10. Unixový operační systém OpenIndiana (Wikipedie) vychází z OpenSolarisu (Wikipedie).

Battlefield REDSEC has plenty of ways for you to mount a comeback, which allows you to redeploy your party members once they're dead.


The system in place in REDSEC is entirely different from other battle royales. For some, this system will feel better. For others, it could appear too overpowered. Either way, this guide will help you learn how to bring back your dead teammates.


How to redeploy in Battlefield REDSEC


To redeploy your dead allies, you don't have to pick up anything from their corpses. Infact, you can be on a completely other part of the map from them and still bring them back to the action quite easily. You'll need to reach a redeployment station.


These stations are located at specific locations on the map and marked by a parachute icon. You'll just have to reach the marked spot to activate the redeployment process. Having more members of your party on the spot will make the redeployment process faster. You don't require any extra items or press any buttons. Just wait for the process to complete, and your buddy will be back in action.


Image via EA


As cool as it sounds, redeployment towers are dangerous locations. Enemy units will be aware of the locations as well, and some of them could camp to take an advantage. So you should always scout your surroundings before venturing out to revive your buddies.


An automatic redeployment system is also available in Battlefield REDSEC. This works at the start of the game and reduces the need for you to reach the redeployment tower. If your allies are down, you just need to survive till the timer is over. While this method is comparatively safer, it's only active during the early rounds.

That was how I felt playing Frostpunk, for example. While I was solving one issue, another one would just pop up, making things more complicated.

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Meta is using a classic BitTorrent defense in its legal battle with adult film producer Strike 3 Holdings. In its motion to dismiss, the tech company argues that IP-address evidence is insufficient to prove who the infringer is. Meta further counters that the "sporadic" downloads on its corporate network began years before its relevant AI research started. Instead of AI training, Meta argues the activity was likely just for "private personal use"
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta: Pirated Adult Film Downloads Were For “Personal Use,” Not AI Training

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Supreme Court battle over a $1 billion piracy judgment against internet provider Cox Communications is one of the decade's pivotal copyright lawsuits. After the ISP received broad support, including from the U.S. Government, a diverse group of amici have now weighed in to support the music labels. This includes the MPA, former members of Congress, the U.S. Copyright Office, as well as the National Center on Sexual Exploitation.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Broad Coalition Backs Record Labels in Supreme Court ISP Piracy Liability Battle

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A lawsuit filed last November by DISH and Sling TV targeted Richard Moy and CLVPN LLC. It was alleged that Moy illegally gained access to the companies' servers and redistributed their TV content to 450,000 users. To mitigate customer concerns that his pirate IPTV service might be unlawful, Moy allegedly claimed law enforcement affiliation. Unable to pay his attorney in August, Moy has just agreed to settle the lawsuit for a "conservative" $44.5 million.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Man Settles Lawsuit For $44.5m Yet Couldn’t Pay His Attorney

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'The Long Walk' tops the chart, followed by 'The Fantastic Four: First Steps'. 'The Conjuring: Last Rites' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 10/27/2025

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
History has shown that if the source of pirated content isn't eliminated, one way or another it will simply reappear somewhere else. Targeting consumer-facing streaming sites does cause disruption, but not as much as targeting the supplier of their streams. Or targeting that supplier's supplier and then hitting the supplier above them. Effective in theory, perhaps, but in the world of 'CDN leeching', pirate streams and legal streams share the same supplier.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: The Streaming Piracy Crisis Suppressant That Nobody Wants To Discuss

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A proposal calling for the Spanish government to protect innocent websites from pirate site overblocking has been rejected. The proposal before the Congressional Committee on Economy, Trade, and Digital Transformation, recognized that football league LaLiga needs to protect its rights, but said safeguards are necessary after the wrongful blocking of thousands of third-party websites.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Proposal to Prevent LaLiga Site-Blocking Hurting Innocent Sites Rejected in Spain

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
European football's governing body, UEFA, has joined global anti-piracy coalition ACE. The move will help the Champions League organizer to more effectively tackle live streaming piracy. While sports piracy is a growing problem, UEFA has also seen a spectacular increase in revenues. This has resulted in costly, fragmented subscriptions for fans, which some see as a primary driver for the very piracy UEFA is trying to defeat.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: UEFA Joins Anti-Piracy Coalition ACE to Protect Growing Revenues from Piracy Surge

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In the modern piracy ecosystem, sites and domains have become disposable, but "brands" often survive. This phenomenon is highlighted by the MPA's latest DMCA subpoena request, which hunts the "ghosts" of already defeated operations. On behalf of ACE, the MPA requests Cloudflare and the .to registry hand over identifying data for 46 domains. The list includes domains linked to notorious "zombie" brands, including FMovies, Aniwave, and 123movies, as well as new "hydra" sites like Nunflix.org.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MPA Targets ‘Zombie’ Pirate Brands Including Fmovies, Cuevana and Aniwave

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A decision by Canal+ to target public DNS resolvers to reinforce pirate site blocking, ended with a French court ordering Cloudflare and Google to deny access to list of streaming sites. A lawyer who acted for Canal+ says that led to measurable progress, despite Cloudflare reportedly making "independent decisions" on which sites to block or not. In the political arena, the U.S. govt. has ordered diplomats to oppose EU law that obliges intermediaries to cooperate with rightsholders.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare ‘Resists’ Piracy Blocks, U.S. Govt. Opposes EU Co-Op Obligations

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every year, the Office of the United States Trade Representative uses input from copyright holders to update its list of notorious piracy markets. The process aims to help combat copyright infringement, but for the past several years, recurring arguments and rebuttals have contributed to a 'Groundhog Day' loop. Recent submissions also reveal various 'copy-paste' efforts, highlighting a persistent standoff between rightsholders and accused parties like Cloudflare.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anti-Piracy Groundhog Day: Recycled Arguments Plague USTR’s Notorious Markets Review

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
DISH Network has filed a new $27 million copyright infringement lawsuit, this time identifying the alleged operators of the Lemo and Kemo IPTV services. The complaint, filed in a Florida federal court, targets a Malaysian company, Kemo E Marketing, and two individuals as the "direct infringers." The suit, which aims to shut down the pirate operations, also names a U.S.-based reseller, '1 Dollar IPTV', which is linked to a now-dissolved company in Florida. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DISH Identifies Lemo/Kemo Pirate IPTV Operators & Sues U.S. Reseller for $27M

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Having established itself as a moving and unpredictable target, it's widely accepted that piracy cannot be defeated using a single tool. Italy's toolbox is one of the most comprehensive available, having just added the ability to effectively fine IPTV pirates twice for the same offense. According to Italy's Minister for Sport and Youth, pirates may soon face the prospect of being named and shamed.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: IPTV Pirates May Soon Be Named and Shamed, Italian Minister Says

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Reports that No-IP's dynamic DNS service had stopped functioning date back more than a week. After blocking the service, Spanish ISPs displayed 'Error 451' and at least one sent requests to 127.0.0.1. For local internet users, artificial internet disruptions like these are now part of everyday life. They arrive unannounced and disappear a few hours later, usually coinciding with football broadcasts sandwiched in the middle. Those who know who's responsible for blocking ddns.net only mention a court order. It doesn't help.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ISP Blocking of No-IP’s Dynamic DNS Enters Week 2

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Rightsholders can breathe a sigh of relief after a California federal court concluded that Cloudflare can be compelled to comply with DMCA subpoenas. The anonymous operator of now-defunct manga piracy site Mangajikan argued that Cloudflare is a 'mere conduit' provider that doesn't have to comply with DMCA subpoenas. However, in a key decision in favor of publisher Shueisha, the court ruled that because Cloudflare caches content, it must identify the operator.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Manga Pirate Site Operator Fails to Dodge DMCA Subpoena Over Cloudflare Cache

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
With a mission to dramatically increase overseas sales of anime, manga, video games, and other creative content by 2033, Japan's Entertainment and Creative Industry Strategy is ambitious and prepared for new risks. Relatively safe licensing models seem to be on the way out, in favor of content companies establishing overseas bases, from where marketing, sales and distribution will be handled directly. Rampant piracy will face a two-pronged strategy, including enhanced enforcement measures targeting areas where piracy causes the most damage.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Direct Sales & Direct Anti-Piracy Action Underpin Japan’s Plan For Explosive Growth

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A group of major record labels has fired back at Cox Communications, asking the Supreme Court to uphold the $1 billion piracy liability verdict. The music companies describe Cox as a hypocritical bad actor, one that prioritized profit over combating piracy. As the ISP stokes fears of innocent grandmas losing their Internet connections, the labels say that Cox terminated half a million customers for failing to pay their bills.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Record Labels Fire Back at Cox in $1B Supreme Court Piracy Case, Cite Termination ‘Hypocrisy’

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The International Federation of the Phonographic Industry is celebrating the shutdown of YouTube-ripping giant Y2Mate.com and 11 similar platforms. IFPI says that during the last 12 months alone, the twelve domains received over 620 million visits from a global audience. The Y2Mate brand has been a thorn in the side of the record labels for years and has been 'permanently' shut down at least once before. Circumstances suggest that the final curtain may prove elusive.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Y2Mate.com Among a Dozen YouTube Rippers Shut Down By IFPI

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Reddit banned 709 subreddits for repeat copyright infringement in the first half of the year. While this is more than double compared to the same period last year, in the grander scheme of removals it's just a speck on the radar. The same holds true for the 837 redditors whose accounts were terminated over copyright violations.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Reddit Banned 709 Subreddits for Repeat Copyright Violations in First Half of 2025

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Many popular AI models are reluctant to discuss piracy, especially when prompts lack finesse and leave zero doubt over intent. Yet even with an entirely lawful context, some models simply refuse to play ball. Such artificial restrictions are not unexpected, but as an incident involving Grok demonstrates, things don't always play out as one might expect yet can end surprisingly well.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Grok’s Lack of Piracy Prompt Panic Isn’t Controversial, It’s Reasonable and Rewarding

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (DreamMaster)
articles.description:
A kingdom in turmoil. Twin princesses kidnapped. And it's up to two intrepid heroes, Hodj and Podj, to compete in a gauntlet of minigames in order to rescue the princesses and escort them back to safety. The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce full support for Hodj 'n' Podj. This is the other Boffo Game that shared the Bagel engine with The Space Bar.
Special thanks go out to the folks at ZOOM Platform for supporting us in adding this game.
Help us test the game by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. And please take some screenshots along the way.
You can challenge the boardgame, run through all the minigames using the Grand Tour, or pick and choose specific minigames to play. Put your skills to the test, with either a one or two player experience, and find out who the true Hodj 'n' Podj champion is.
>
articles.title: A Hodgepodge of Fun Minigames

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (kelmer)
articles.description:
Halloween is creeping closer… and what better way to celebrate than with a brand new game ready for testing in ScummVM?
We’re thrilled to announce that Trick or Treat, a Halloween-themed 1994 point and click adventure by ACA Soft, is now ready for public testing in the latest ScummVM daily builds!
As with all new game engines added to ScummVM, we need your help to ensure everything runs smoothly before declaring it officially supported. Grab your copy of Trick or Treat, fire up the latest daily build, and see how it fares!
Please report any issues you encounter to our bug tracker, following our usual testing guidelines. Screenshots, save files, and detailed notes are always appreciated.
So light a pumpkin and get ready to test Trick or Treat this spooky season!
>
articles.title: Get ready for the season by testing Trick or Treat!

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (mduggan)
articles.description:
We are happy to announce that Tex Murphy 2: Martian Memorandum is now ready for testing in ScummVM.
Martian Memorandum is the second game in the Tex Murphy  series, set in a dark version of the future circa 2039. You play private investigator Tex Murphy, who has been hired by the founder of TerraForm Corporation, Marshall Alexander, to locate his missing daughter Alexis. It seems like it might be a simple kidnapping, but the clues quickly lead to a much bigger mystery.
This is the second game in ScummVM using the Access Software engine – the first, Amazon: Guardians of Eden, was added nearly 10 years ago.
To test Martian Memorandum you’ll need the game files (available from GOG or Steam) and a daily development build. Be sure to check the notes on the wiki for the game, and please report any bugs on our issue tracker.
>
articles.title: “We’ve got a new case and you won’t believe who it involves!"

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Helco)
articles.description:
Dr. Bacterio has a new invention, and it's your job to test it. Work your way through classic Hollywood films while somehow finding the time to save the real world from the mummy.
Whether you have the Spanish Mortadelo y Filemón: Aventura de Cine Edición especial or the German Clever & Smart: A Movie Adventure (check out the demo here), the daily build will transport you to the world of Film Noir in no time. The ScummVM Team would be grateful for any feedback you could share on your journey to meet Billy the Kid or Freddy Krueger.
Just a quick reminder that the Steam version has English subtitles for players who don't speak Spanish or German.
Before you start your test run, please read through our testing guidelines and take some screenshots along the way.
Now don't let the Super wait!
>
articles.title: Lights, Camera, Action for Mort and Phil

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Vzhledem k tomu, že je to vlastně artfilm, jsem byl velmi potěšen tím, jak to všechno působivě vypadá (a zní). Ale to celkové WTF (prolínání víceúrovňových snů a podobenství) mi po dvou hodinách připadalo už poněkud nudné a postrádal jsem nějaký závěrečný klíč, s jehož pomocí by to do sebe všechno zapadlo. Čímž se "Mistr a Markétka" dost podobá filmům "Megalopolis" nebo "Brazil". (Ilča 90 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Mistr a Markétka [Мастер и Маргарита] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: První díl sice měl naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj, ale docela působivou retro atmosféru. Pokračování má také naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj (hodně připomínající libovolné pokračování "Noční můry v Elm Street"), ale velmi překvapivě (vzhledem ke stejnému režisérovi) mu chybí většina té působivé atmosféry, některé scény jsou nechtěně vtipné (strašidelné mrtvé děti za sklem) a film je delší, takže se všechno mnohem víc vleče. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Černý telefon 2 [Black Phone 2] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: "Pocitový" film s dobře fungující atmosférou a výbornými herci, kterému podráží nohy extrémní délka a extrémní pomalost všeho, co se v něm děje. Při třetím pomalém švenkování po stejné černobílé fotografii jsem zažíval téměř psychoteror a po 90 minutách jsem vážně uvažoval, že odejdu ze sálu. Námět je v mnoha ohledech podobný filmu "Hodiny" (2002), takže pokud vám ten připadal příliš komerční a přímočarý, "Pohled do slunce" zahraje na vaši artovou notu. (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Pohled do slunce [In die Sonne schauen] - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Poměrně originální hororově komediální variace, ze které bych byl znatelně nadšenější, kdybych pár měsíců předtím neviděl film Substance (který je výrazně nápaditější a lépe natočený). (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Ošklivá sestra [Den stygge stesøsteren] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Místy úderný videoklip s fajn vizuály a hudbou. Žádná z postav mě ale nezaujala. Scénář je velmi špatný, ignorující většinu potenciálně zajímavých zápletek a v různých ohledech odporující předchozím filmům, i když na ně výslovně odkazuje. Disney bohužel "zprznil" odkaz původního Trona podobně jako to udělal se Star Wars. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Tron: Ares - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Potenciálně zajímavý námět, který bohužel shazuje špatný scénář, špatná režie a špatné skoro všechno ostatní. Ne tak úžasně špatné jako třeba "Kněžna Libuše", ale jenom "špatné" ve smyslu "nekvalitní a nezajímavé". Dlouho jsem nezažil, aby se mi 90 minut v kině takhle hrozně vleklo. Je to škoda, protože základní myšlenka byla zajímavá a herci se snažili. Specificky bych zdůraznil extrémně odbytou hudbu ve chvílích, které si přímo říkaly o silné hudební motivy. (Ilča 20 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Fichtelberg - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Natočit magický realismus tak, aby fungoval, je extrémně těžké. Tenhle pokus klopýtá ve všech aspektech a pro kinofanouška je užitečné analyzovat tento film v kontrastu s "Hřištěm snů", které se zabývá podobnými tématy a dělá to mnohem lépe. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Velká odvážná nádherná cesta [A Big Bold Beautiful Journey] - 40 %

It was discovered that the REXML module bunded into Ruby incorrectly
handled parsing XML documents with repeated instances of certain
characters. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause REXML to
consume excessive resources, leading to a denial of service. Ubuntu 18.04
LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS were previously addressed in USN-7256-1 and
USN-7734-1. This update addresses the issue in Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.
(CVE-2024-35176)

handled parsing XML documents with repeated instances of certain
characters. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause REXML to
consume excessive resources, leading to a denial of service. Ubuntu 20.04
LTS was previously addressed in USN-7256-1. This update addresses the issue
in Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2024-39908, CVE-2024-41123)

handled parsing XML documents with many entity expansions. An attacker
could possibly use this issue to cause REXML to consume excessive
resources, leading to a denial of service. Ubuntu 20.04 LTS was previously
addressed in USN-7091-2. This update addresses the issue in Ubuntu 16.04
LTS and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2024-41946)

handled having both a Content-Length header and a Transfer-Encoding header.
A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform a HTTP request
smuggling attack. (CVE-2024-47220)

It was discovered that the WEBrick module bundled into Ruby incorrectly
parsed HTTP headers. In configurations where the WEBrick module is placed
behind an HTTP proxy, a remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
perform an HTTP Request Smuggling attack. (CVE-2025-6442)
